title: Glowing glasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- left lens frame -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='50' r='17' fill='none' stroke='#7fd8ff' stroke-width='5'/>
  <!-- right lens frame -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='50' r='17' fill='none' stroke='#7fd8ff' stroke-width='5'/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <path d='M49 50 Q50 45 51 50' fill='none' stroke='#7fd8ff' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left temple arm -->
  <path d='M15 44 L4 40' fill='none' stroke='#7fd8ff' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- right temple arm -->
  <path d='M85 44 L96 40' fill='none' stroke='#7fd8ff' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left lens glass shine/bubble -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='44' r='6' fill='#3aaee0' opacity='0.55'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='57' r='3' fill='#3aaee0' opacity='0.45'/>
  <!-- right lens glass shine/bubble -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='44' r='6' fill='#3aaee0' opacity='0.55'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='57' r='3' fill='#3aaee0' opacity='0.45'/>
  <!-- little sparkle highlights -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='40' r='1.6' fill='#eafcff'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='40' r='1.6' fill='#eafcff'/>
</svg>
